basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid gamer and budding blacksmith from the Midwest. I recently picked up an interest in historical reenactment and love spending my weekends practicing blacksmithing techniques. I'm currently working as a junior IT technician, which means I spend a lot of time in front of the computer both for work and leisure. My partner and I enjoy cozy movie nights, especially films from the Criterion Channel. I usually hop onto Reddit after work hours, around 7 PM, and often stay up late exploring new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT, having studied Information Systems at a community college. My interest in blacksmithing is relatively new, sparked by YouTube tutorials and local workshops. I'm also passionate about gaming, particularly action-adventure titles, which often leads me to explore related subreddits.
